0022600027.text: The 76ers come in at 8-1, first in the Atlantic and first in the East, on a five-game winning streak and a perfect 4-0 on the road, while the Cavaliers are 4-4, sixth in the East, and on a two-game losing streak. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (out, ankle sprain) and has Jarrett Allen (knee) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, following a 0-4 series loss to the Cavaliers in 2025-26.
